experiments.hypothesis: Deterministic repairs and stricter quality checks change how many second attempts are needed.
experiments.change: Current verifier + retry policy replayed on the recorded first-attempt outputs of EXP-010 (scripts/replay-attempts.ts; outputs recovered offline from the response cache).

retried.ch-2: still retried (now also flagged: mentions derivatives)
retried.g8: still retried (false similarity claim — a correct retry)
retried.w1: NEW retry: hints/steps in Vietnamese without diacritics

realUsageCauses.source: worker log of the user's 4 two-attempt solves

causes.malformed figure check reported as a fal: now normalised / set aside (no retry, lesson no longer unverified)
causes.empty model output: now retried inside the call one effort step lower

experiments.conclusion: On benchmark outputs the new quality rules add one justified retry (undiacritized Vietnamese); on the real solves the deterministic repairs remove the causes of 2 of 4 second attempts. Net latency effect: needs the live run (OPT-005).
experiments.limitations: Replay is instant, so the 150 s retry budget is not exercised; real-solve outputs were not cached, so their effect is inferred from the logged reasons.
